title: Basics & Manipulations
description: Parse, transform, compare, and scan strings using direct character-level rules.
identify: The problem asks you to transform or validate a string without changing the relative meaning of characters.
A direct scan, two pointers, or small fixed-size map is enough.
The important details are whitespace, character mapping, overflow, or substring boundaries.
The alphabet is small or bounded, so O(1) auxiliary maps are often possible.
explanation: Most basic string problems are won by carefully defining the scan rule. Decide what each character means, what state must be remembered, and when the scan should stop or reset.
